season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep with late July through September best; Wikipedia says July through September gives the most favorable weather; searches found no snow-free window specific to the Needles; the approach gullies hold snow into early July in average years.

track.why: Only one route is stored on Walkinshaw. The Jul 16 2023 track goes car to car from Upper Dungeness Trailhead (22 m from our pin) to the summit (59 m on the sparse shape, 4 m by Peakbagger highpoint) and back, with the Royal Basin line and about 4,900 ft of gain matching the stored approach.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Jun 8 2025, complete and summited but early for the snow-free window; second choice.
Aug 4 2024 logged Northeast Face; reaches the ridge by a different, bushy and loose gully the climber advises against, and continues over Gray Wolf Ridge and Baldy to Tyler Peak.
Jun 21 2019, track starts at Royal Basin, not the trailhead: partial; early season.
Sep 27 2023 report only; no track harvested.

facts.text: In early August the cairned path along the ridge to the summit has exposure only near the start along a ledge; the west of the two summit knobs looks higher and holds the register.
In late September the 10 ft step before the final plateau could be skirted on the climbers left without a rope; one unexposed class 4 stemming move comes about two thirds up the final mass.
By late September the scree up to the ridge is slippery and tiresome, and no water is found on the ridge.
Ice axe as a scree stabilizer (late season)
In early August the steep gully from the Royal Basin Trail to the ridge was bushy, loose and exposed with a couple of class 4 moves; a line farther south seemed gentler.

notes: Single route; Upper Dungeness Trailhead pin matches every complete track (22-56 m). Summit pin is within 59 m of the tracks and Peakbagger. Walkinshaw trackChecks show our Royal Lake camp pin 2.3 km from the sparse track but the tracks are only ~42 points so that is not conclusive.
